completion:
Find the "Official/Witness"'(non-detection limit 1 = 0.0, and non-detection limit 2 = 1.0) line.
3. Find the specific "pipe sample" inside the hydrant (see numbered hydrant in inspection image).
4. If you detected lead above $0.0 \mu\text{g}/\text{L}$ and below $1.0 \mu\text{g}/\text{L}$, ask yourself if the test result occurred above or below the "Official/Witness" line. If below the line, report this as a value between $0.0$ and $<1.0 \mu\text{g}/\text{L}$. If above the line, report the lead result at the actual detection value obtained from the analytical laboratory.
